_comment: Fleet-level settings, read at startup by the scripts in bin/. Copy to fleet.json and edit. Every key the scripts read appears here; keys prefixed with _ are comments for the optional ones, which are safe to leave out. Per-agent settings (model, effort, bot id, channel) live in that agent's own config.json, not here.
_agents_dir: Optional. Where the agent directories live. Absolute, or relative to the fleet root. Defaults to <fleet root>/agents.
_watcher_token_file: Optional. Which bot token the mention watcher polls with. Defaults to the first agent's .env, and any bot in the server can poll, so most fleets never set this.
